_doc: Dark Knight line (spec #348, ticket D2 #350). Skills are defined here by D5-D9 (spec #348). Skill keys a job names before they are defined stay inert: undefined skills are never offered or learned. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in skills/hero.json (DK-13): never define them here.

spear_crusher._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311001 at its eight mapped levels (4 8 12 15 23 25 27 30): damage 70 to 170 %, attackCount 2 (levels 1-15) or 3 (16-30), mobCount 1 to 3, the box lt (-130,-50) growing to (-150,-70) with rb (-16,0) (a 16 px dead zone in front of the knight), the per-level body action (burster1 for two hits, burster2 for three), the wings (effect) and rune rings (effect0), the K-th dragon thrust (effect1..3), hit/0 and the Use sound; the pole arm twin 1311002 has identical numbers and nodes. Tier B: effectK is the K-th thrust (D1 contact sheet; the blank wait of effect1/2/3 is 600/750/900 ms, the body's thrusts land there). Tier C: the explicit ranks table (DK-7: the default level-30 table lands rank 5 on level 19, where mobCount falls back to 1, so the rank would deal less than rank 4), the 0.6 s cooldown, the nearest-target admission (min_targets 1), the bonuses, a Final Attack hit also showing its thrust. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.68.
spear_crusher.name: Spear Crusher
spear_crusher.desc: Thrust your spear into the monsters in front of you, two or three times.

text.desc: Thrust your weapon into the monsters in front of you.

dragon_fury._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311003 damage 80 to 250 % (rank 1 = level 4: 110 %), mobCount 6, hpCon 20 to 30, action swingP1, the reach box = the skill's own afterimage rectangle spear/swingP1 lt (-241,-81) rb (-16,31) (the pole arm twin 1311004 is identical), effect, effect0, hit/0 and the Use sound. Tier C: the 1.2 s cooldown, the box cast needing one mob, the 0.8 s stance hold (the body action's own delays), rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.69.
dragon_fury.name: Dragon Fury
dragon_fury.desc: Swings the spear in a long sweep across six monsters, for a few HP.

text.desc: Sweep your spear or pole arm across a long reach in front of you. Costs HP, never the last point.

cast_visuals._provenance: Tier A: afterimage at swingP1 frame 2, after 300 + 150 ms body frames. Tier C: follow the caster and use the spear trail for other weapon families.

sacrifice._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311005 damage 205 to 350 % (rank 1 = level 4: 220 %), x 20 to 5 (% of the damage dealt, String.wz agrees; rank 1 = 18 %), the effect (2 frames, z -1), the Use sound; no action, no hit, no mobCount, no attackCount in the node. Tier C: the single hit at the held weapon's reach (weapon_reach), the weapon's own first-swing stance and hit spark, the 2.0 s cooldown, the recoil rules (10 % of max HP cap, never the last HP; HpRisk), the dropped defence-disable half (no mob debuff exists), rarity bonuses (Achilles, Berserk). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.69.
sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Deals a heavy blow to one monster within your weapon's reach, hurting you for a share of the damage.

text.desc: Strike one monster within your weapon's reach for a heavy blow. The blow hurts you, but never takes your last HP.

dragon_roar._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311006 damage 96 to 240 % (rank 1 = level 4: 114 %), mobCount 15, the symmetric lt/rb box ((-140,-155)..(140,55) at rank 1 up to (-400,-350)..(400,250)), x (HP cost, % of max HP: 56 to 30 at the ranks, DK-2 verified against the String.wz level-1 line), y (stun seconds: 4 to 2), the alert3 action, the 18-frame effect, the 3-frame hit art and the Use sound; the String.wz line 'works only when more than 50% of HP is left' is the hp_gate. The node has no prop, so the stun has no chance_field and always lands (bosses take no statuses). Tier C: the 10 s cooldown (DK-9), min_targets 3, reading x as a share of max HP (the cost is floor(x/100 x max HP) from current HP, never lethal), the 0.6 s action hold, the default 30-level rank table. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
dragon_roar._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #355 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #348): Rare Mastery damage x1.2, Epic Super Dragon Roar area x1.2 (the box scales), Unique Dragon Blood HP cost x0.75, Legendary Dragon Blood plus damage x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
dragon_roar.name: Dragon Roar
dragon_roar.desc: Roars at the whole screen, hurting and stunning every monster, at a great cost in HP.

text.desc: Roar to damage and stun up to 15 monsters on the screen. Costs a share of your max HP and needs more than half of it left. Needs 3 monsters in the roar's box.
text.h: Costs {hp_cost} HP. Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; stun for {y} sec.

legendary.text: Dragon Blood: HP cost and damage

rush_dark_knight._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321003 (Dark Knight's Rush, D1 #349): the same level table as Hero's 1121006 at every level (rank 1 = WZ level 4: damage 78 %, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) rb (0,0); rank 8 = level 30: 130 %, (-250,-50)); the body action `rush` (the node's own `action`; Hero's node says rush2); effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound through the UOL. Tier C: the 2.0 s cooldown, the always-on 80 px knock-back in the dash direction, hold-to-repeat, no start while climbing, no orb, the bot dashes away from a mob within 60 px at most every 3 s: copied from Hero's Rush (#356, spec #348 DK-14).
rush_dark_knight.name: Rush
rush_dark_knight.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

monster_magnet_dark_knight._rarity: tier C: Hero's Magnet bonuses copied (#356, spec #348 DK-14): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.71.
monster_magnet_dark_knight._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321001 (D1 #349): range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6 (equal to Hero's 1121001 in every level row), the 18-frame effect (the same horseshoe art as Hero's Magnet) and the Use sound through the UOL. Tier C: no damage (the node has none); pulling is the shared `pull` block (7.35); the alert2 action (the node names none), the 4 s cooldown (Hero's tuned value, #346), the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`) and the 0.6 s action hold. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.71.
monster_magnet_dark_knight.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet_dark_knight.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.

beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1321007 art (summon summoned/stand/move/die/skill1-6, the owner-side affected column), the alert2 stance, the Use sound, ranks reading Beholder levels 2 3 4 5 7 8 9 10 through rank_levels["10"]. Tier B: skill1 is the Aura animation and skill2-6 the five Hex runes (D1 contact sheet); affected plays on the knight at each pulse (D4). Tier C: the 60 s life (buff.duration, the WZ time is 720-1200 s, DK-6), the 45 s cooldown counted from the cast, the 3 s first Hex pulse, the follow settings (Elquines'), the bonuses. WZ mpCon and mastery are not used. Aura and Hex are the sub-skills below. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.67.
beholder._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #357 bonuses (spec #348): Rare Aura of the Beholder heal x1.3 (support_heal), Epic Hex of the Beholder pulses 25% sooner (support_rate x0.75), Unique Twin Beholder +1 Beholder (summon_count), Legendary Twin plus heal x1.3 (the Beholder has no damage; Twin shares one id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.67 and 8.
beholder.name: Beholder
beholder.desc: Summon a Beholder who floats beside you, heals you and buffs your defence, accuracy, avoidability and attack.

text.desc: Summons a Beholder that follows you. It heals you with Aura of the Beholder and buffs you with Hex of the Beholder.

aura_of_the_beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1320008 canonical hp (85 to 500, flat) and x (10 to 4 s) at the eight sub levels. A summon_sub of the Beholder (DK-4): never owned, never in a pool, no card; it ranks with its parent through this explicit table (a level-25 skill has no default table). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.67.
aura_of_the_beholder.name: Aura of the Beholder
aura_of_the_beholder.desc: The Beholder heals you every few seconds.

hex_of_the_beholder._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1320009 canonical pdd mdd acc eva pad (each from its unlock level 1 6 11 16 21), time and x at the eight sub levels; a stat absent from the level is not carried. WZ eva is the avoid total and pad the weapon attack (tier C mapping). A summon_sub of the Beholder (DK-4, DK-5): every unlocked stat applies together, a pulse refreshes the one buff entry. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.67.
hex_of_the_beholder.name: Hex of the Beholder
hex_of_the_beholder.desc: The Beholder buffs your defence, accuracy, avoidability and attack every few seconds.
